required_nodes.rationale: Exact request bytes are admitted only through a complete one-shot binding and are cleared after handoff.
A structured external answer is scored against the independent key only after exact durable receipt and response provenance checks.
Composed evidence reaches the existing external controller only after runtime admission and credential binding, and its response is scored from the durable receipt.
Failed inference remains an explicit insufficient observation and cannot become a scored pass.
A provider response accompanying a failed inference remains digest-bound evidence and is not scored as a successful answer.
Tampered durable receipt bindings and substituted response metadata fail closed.
HTTPS egress can use the managed proxy tunnel while preserving the exact target and credential boundary.
The selected model-aware encoder emits exact endpoint-specific request framing and binds generation limits and model identity.
Runtime keyring dependency remains declared and an absent operator credential fails with the existing sanitized error.
An unavailable optional keyring package is mapped to the existing sanitized credential-backend error without manufacturing a credential.
